payload.name: HIV-1 inhibitor activity against SARS-CoV-2
payload.fact: Nevirapine, amprenavir, and ALLINI-2 modestly inhibit SARS-CoV-2 replication, though with higher IC50 values than required for HIV-1.

provenance.title: A Simplified Quantitative Real-Time PCR Assay for Monitoring SARS-CoV-2 Growth in Cell Culture
provenance.quote_or_locus: HIV-1-specific inhibitors nevirapine (a nonnucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor [NNRTI]), amprenavir (a protease inhibitor), and allosteric integrase inhibitor 2 (ALLINI-2) modestly inhibited SARS-CoV-2 replication, albeit the 50% inhibitory concentration (IC50) values were much higher than that required for HIV-1
